svg.aria-label: podbag intro. Other engines keep daemons running; podbag runs only while containers run, and nothing at rest. Others store layers; podbag stores files, each once: 902 MiB of disk instead of 2,970 MiB for 8 Spring services in 2 releases, and 324 MiB of page cache instead of 982 MiB. A container starts in 4.1 ms, 18 times faster than Docker's 73.8 ms. Linux, macOS and Windows; podbag.dev.
svg.title: podbag: a container engine that works differently

g.text: A container engine that works differently
podbag runs only while containers run
Others store layers. podbag stores files.
8 Spring services in 2 releases: 902 MiB instead of 2,970 MiB
Files stored once are cached once
Memory read to start 16 Spring services (page cache)
Containers that read the same file share one copy in memory.
Start a container: median of 100 runs on Linux
One static binary. No daemon to ask. No shim to start.
Linux · macOS · Windows · x86_64 and arm64
